caption:
Moving to Boonton? The problem isn't you. It's driving past Main Street. Park once and see 3 stops on one street.

Downtown Boonton's historic district runs along Main, Church, Birch, Cornelia and Cedar Streets and has been on the National Register of Historic Places since 1980. Walk down to Grace Lord Park at West Main Street and Essex Avenue for the falls on the Rockaway River and the start of the Boonton Heritage Trail. Then head to NJ Transit's Boonton station at Main Street and Route 202 on the Montclair-Boonton Line.

Touring homes in Boonton? Walk from the house to Main Street and the station before you decide.
